# Ghazali Handicrafts

> Authentic Pakistani Artisanal Heritage and Crafts Studio established in 1976 in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Core Specializations
- Multani Blue Pottery (Kashigari): Hand-glazed urns, wall plates, tea sets made with cobalt and lapis pigments.
- Swati Walnut Woodwork: Deep hand-relief chiseled trays, bridal chest boxes, tables from Swat Valley.
- Miniature Truck Art: Authentic hand-painted metal trucks, chamba reflective chamka art, kettles.
- Marble & Onyx: Hand-carved desk clocks, sailboat sculptures, mortar & pestle (chatuwata).
- Himalayan Salt: Khewra raw salt lamps with solid wood bases.

## Operations & Logistics
- Storefront: New Anarkali Bazaar, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan.
- Nationwide Delivery: 100% Cash on Delivery across Pakistan.
- Fragile Packaging: Museum-grade multi-layer wooden batten and bubble double-crating with zero-breakage guarantee.
- WhatsApp Concierge & Direct Orders: +92 310 4755973
